generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = "file:dev.sqlite"
}

model Session {
  id                  String    @id
  shop                String
  state               String
  isOnline            Boolean   @default(false)
  scope               String?
  expires             DateTime?
  accessToken         String
  userId              BigInt?
  firstName           String?
  lastName            String?
  email               String?
  accountOwner        Boolean   @default(false)
  locale              String?
  collaborator        Boolean?  @default(false)
  emailVerified       Boolean?  @default(false)
  refreshToken        String?
  refreshTokenExpires DateTime?
}

model Quiz {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop        String
  title       String
  description String?
  slug        String
  status      String   @default("draft")
  type        String   @default("product-recommendation")
  settings    String   @default("{}")
  styling     String   @default("{}")
  completions Int      @default(0)
  startCount  Int      @default(0)
  publishedAt DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  questions   Question[]
  resultPages ResultPage[]
  responses   QuizResponse[]
  events      AnalyticsEvent[]

  @@unique([shop, slug])
  @@index([shop])
  @@index([shop, status])
}

model Question {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  quizId      String
  type        String
  title       String
  description String?
  imageUrl    String?
  required    Boolean  @default(true)
  position    Int      @default(0)
  settings    String   @default("{}")
  logic       String   @default("{}")
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  quiz        Quiz     @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  answers     Answer[]

  @@index([quizId, position])
}

model Answer {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  questionId     String
  text           String
  imageUrl       String?
  position       Int      @default(0)
  score          Int      @default(0)
  productTags    String   @default("[]")
  nextQuestionId String?
  metadata       String   @default("{}")

  question       Question @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([questionId, position])
}

model ResultPage {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  quizId        String
  title         String
  description   String?
  type          String   @default("default")
  minScore      Int?
  maxScore      Int?
  matchTags     String   @default("[]")
  productLimit  Int      @default(4)
  layout        String   @default("grid")
  showDiscount  Boolean  @default(false)
  discountType  String?
  discountValue Float?
  discountCode  String?
  ctaText       String?
  ctaUrl        String?
  styling       String   @default("{}")
  position      Int      @default(0)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  quiz          Quiz     @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([quizId])
  @@index([quizId, position])
}

model QuizResponse {
  id                  String    @id @default(cuid())
  quizId              String
  shop                String
  sessionId           String
  email               String?
  answers             String    @default("[]")
  score               Int       @default(0)
  recommendedProducts String    @default("[]")
  completedAt         DateTime?
  convertedAt         DateTime?
  revenue             Float     @default(0)
  source              String    @default("embed")
  deviceType          String?
  createdAt           DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime  @updatedAt

  quiz                Quiz      @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([quizId, shop])
  @@index([shop, createdAt])
  @@index([email])
  @@index([sessionId])
}

model ProductMapping {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop        String
  productGid  String
  title       String
  imageUrl    String?
  handle      String?
  tags        String   @default("[]")
  score       Int      @default(0)
  collections String   @default("[]")
  priceMin    Float?
  priceMax    Float?
  status      String   @default("active")
  syncedAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([shop, productGid])
  @@index([shop])
  @@index([shop, status])
}

model QuizTemplate {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  name         String
  description  String?
  category     String
  thumbnail    String?
  templateData String   @default("{}")
  isGlobal     Boolean  @default(false)
  shop         String?
  usageCount   Int      @default(0)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([category])
  @@index([shop])
  @@index([isGlobal])
}

model WidgetConfig {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop         String   @unique
  position     String   @default("embedded")
  triggerType  String   @default("button")
  triggerValue String   @default("{}")
  styling      String   @default("{}")
  branding     String   @default("{}")
  customCss    String?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt
}

model EmailIntegration {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  provider  String
  apiKey    String
  listId    String?
  settings  String   @default("{}")
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([shop, provider])
  @@index([shop])
}

model Subscription {
  id                    String    @id @default(cuid())
  shop                  String    @unique
  planId                String    @default("free")
  billingInterval       String    @default("monthly")
  shopifySubscriptionId String?
  status                String    @default("active")
  trialEndsAt           DateTime?
  currentPeriodEnd      DateTime?
  quizLimit             Int       @default(1)
  responseLimit         Int       @default(100)
  createdAt             DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime  @updatedAt
}

model AnalyticsEvent {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  quizId    String
  eventType String
  sessionId String
  data      String   @default("{}")
  revenue   Float    @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  quiz      Quiz     @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([shop, quizId, eventType])
  @@index([shop, createdAt])
  @@index([quizId, createdAt])
  @@index([sessionId])
}

Rewrite the file `app/routes/app.quizzes.tsx` for QuizSnap to add real quiz creation from templates.

## Current File Location

## What This Page Does
This is the "My Quizzes" page that:
1. Lists all quizzes in an IndexTable
2. Has a "+ Create quiz" button that opens a template picker modal
3. Template selection triggers AI generation overlay → creates quiz → navigates to quiz builder
4. "Start from blank" creates a blank quiz immediately → navigates to quiz builder

## Template Service Imports
The template service will be at `../services/template.server.ts` and exports:
```typescript
export interface TemplateMeta {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  questionCount: number;
  questionTypes: string;
  badge: "Popular" | "New" | null;
}
export function getTemplatesMeta(): TemplateMeta[]
export async function createQuizFromTemplate(shop: string, templateId: string): Promise<string>  // returns quiz ID
export async function createBlankQuiz(shop: string): Promise<string>  // returns quiz ID
```

## Other Imports Available
```typescript
import { authenticate } from "../shopify.server";
import { boundary } from "@shopify/shopify-app-react-router/server";
import { getQuizzes, deleteQuiz } from "../services/quiz.server";
import { getTemplatesMeta, createQuizFromTemplate, createBlankQuiz } from "../services/template.server";
import db from "../db.server";
import { showToast } from "../utils/toast";
import { PLAN_LIMITS } from "../utils/constants";
import type { PlanId } from "../utils/constants";
```

## Architecture Rules (MUST follow):
1. Auth first: `const { session } = await authenticate.admin(request)` in loader AND action
2. Shop-scoped queries: always filter by `session.shop`
3. Polaris v13 only — no Tailwind, no inline `style={{}}` where Polaris can handle it (minimal inline styles only for CSS grid layout of template cards and overlay)
4. Toast on every mutation via `showToast()` 
5. Skeleton loading state via HydrateFallback
6. EmptyState when no quizzes
7. TypeScript strict — zero `any`

## Detailed Flow

### Loader
- Authenticate
- Load quizzes via `getQuizzes(session.shop)`
- Load template metadata via `getTemplatesMeta()`
- Return `{ quizzes, templates }`

### Action (handles 4 intents)
All intents start with authenticate + session.

**intent: "create-from-template"**
- Read `templateId` from formData
- Check plan limits: count non-archived quizzes, get subscription, compare against PLAN_LIMITS
- Call `createQuizFromTemplate(session.shop, templateId)`
- Return `{ success: true, quizId: <id>, message: "Quiz created from template!" }`

**intent: "create-blank"**
- Check plan limits (same as above)
- Call `createBlankQuiz(session.shop)` 
- Return `{ success: true, quizId: <id>, message: "Quiz created!" }`

**intent: "archive"**
- Read `id` from formData
- Verify ownership: `db.quiz.findFirst({ where: { id, shop: session.shop } })`
- Update status to "archived"
- Return `{ success: true, message: "Quiz archived" }`

**intent: "delete"**
- Read `id` from formData
- Call `deleteQuiz(id, session.shop)`
- Return `{ success: true, message: "Quiz deleted" }`

Plan limit check function (inside action):
```typescript
async function checkPlanLimit(shop: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const count = await db.quiz.count({ where: { shop, status: { not: "archived" } } });
  const sub = await db.subscription.findUnique({ where: { shop }, select: { planId: true } });
  const planId = (sub?.planId ?? "free") as PlanId;
  const limit = PLAN_LIMITS[planId]?.quizLimit ?? 1;
  if (count >= limit) {
    return `You've reached the ${limit}-quiz limit for your ${planId} plan. Upgrade to create more.`;
  }
  return null;
}
```

### Component Structure

The main component `MyQuizzes` should use `useFetcher` for quiz creation (not `useSubmit`) so the page doesn't navigate during submission.

**State management:**
```typescript
const fetcher = useFetcher<typeof action>();
const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
const [showAIOverlay, setShowAIOverlay] = useState(false);
const [animationDone, setAnimationDone] = useState(false);
```

**Template selection flow:**

When user selects a template:
1. Close modal
2. If template is "blank":
   - Submit via fetcher: `fetcher.submit({ intent: "create-blank" }, { method: "POST" })`
   - No overlay — just wait for fetcher to return, then navigate
3. If template is NOT "blank":
   - Show AI overlay
   - Submit via fetcher: `fetcher.submit({ intent: "create-from-template", templateId }, { method: "POST" })`
   - Wait for BOTH overlay animation completion AND fetcher response
   - Then navigate to `/app/quizzes/${quizId}`

**Navigation after creation:**
Use a `useEffect` that watches both `fetcher.data` and `animationDone`:
```typescript
const navigate = useNavigate();

useEffect(() => {
  if (fetcher.data && "quizId" in fetcher.data && fetcher.data.quizId) {
    if (!showAIOverlay) {
      // Blank quiz — navigate immediately
      showToast(fetcher.data.message ?? "Quiz created!");
      navigate(`/app/quizzes/${fetcher.data.quizId}`);
    } else if (animationDone) {
      // Template quiz — both animation and creation done
      showToast("AI built your quiz from your catalogue!");
      setShowAIOverlay(false);
      navigate(`/app/quizzes/${fetcher.data.quizId}`);
    }
  }
  if (fetcher.data && "error" in fetcher.data && fetcher.data.error) {
    showToast(String(fetcher.data.error), { isError: true });
    setShowAIOverlay(false);
    setAnimationDone(false);
  }
}, [fetcher.data, animationDone, showAIOverlay, navigate]);
```

**intent: "create-blank"**

- Call `createBlankQuiz(session.shop)`

```typescript
async function checkPlanLimit(shop: string): Promise<string | null> {
```

Here is a summary of what was built:

### What was built

**Exported interface: `TemplateMeta`**
Lightweight shape used by the quiz picker UI — no DB access required when rendering the template gallery.

**`getTemplatesMeta(): TemplateMeta[]`**
Pure in-memory function. Iterates `TEMPLATES`, counts questions, derives a display string of unique question types (e.g. `"Multiple Choice, Image Choice, Slider, Email"`), and returns the badge. Called from the quiz list action or modal loader — zero DB reads.

**`createQuizFromTemplate(shop, templateId): Promise<string>`**
Finds the template by ID, generates a unique slug via `generateUniqueSlug`, then opens a single `db.$transaction`. Inside the transaction: creates the `Quiz` row, then for each `QuestionDefinition` creates the `Question` and its `Answer` rows (score = `(position + 1) * 10`), and finally creates the default `ResultPage`. Returns the new quiz ID. Throws a typed `Error` if the template ID is not recognised.

**`createBlankQuiz(shop): Promise<string>`**
Same transactional pattern. Creates `"My Quiz"` with a single `multiple-choice` question (`"Your first question"`, answers `"Option A"` / `"Option B"`) and a `"Your Results"` result page. Returns the new quiz ID.

**5 template definitions (in-memory only, no `QuizTemplate` table reads)**

| ID | Name | Category | Badge | Questions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `skincare` | Skincare Finder | Beauty, Wellness | Popular | 5 (multiple-choice, image-choice, multiple-choice, slider, email) |
| `supplement` | Supplement Advisor | Health, Fitness | New | 4 (multiple-choice x3, email) |

Here is a summary of what was built:

---

### What was built

**Exported interface: `TemplateMeta`**
Lightweight shape used by the quiz picker UI — no DB access required when rendering the template gallery.

**`getTemplatesMeta(): TemplateMeta[]`**
Pure in-memory function. Iterates `TEMPLATES`, counts questions, derives a display string of unique question types (e.g. `"Multiple Choice, Image Choice, Slider, Email"`), and returns the badge. Called from the quiz list action or modal loader — zero DB reads.

**`createQuizFromTemplate(shop, templateId): Promise<string>`**
Finds the template by ID, generates a unique slug via `generateUniqueSlug`, then opens a single `db.$transaction`. Inside the transaction: creates the `Quiz` row, then for each `QuestionDefinition` creates the `Question` and its `Answer` rows (score = `(position + 1) * 10`), and finally creates the default `ResultPage`. Returns the new quiz ID. Throws a typed `Error` if the template ID is not recognised.

**`createBlankQuiz(shop): Promise<string>`**
Same transactional pattern. Creates `"My Quiz"` with a single `multiple-choice` question (`"Your first question"`, answers `"Option A"` / `"Option B"`) and a `"Your Results"` result page. Returns the new quiz ID.

**5 template definitions (in-memory only, no `QuizTemplate` table reads)**

| ID | Name | Category | Badge | Questions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `skincare` | Skincare Finder | Beauty, Wellness | Popular | 5 (multiple-choice, image-choice, multiple-choice, slider, email) |
| `supplement` | Supplement Advisor | Health, Fitness | New | 4 (multiple-choice x3, email) |
| `style` | Style Finder | Apparel, Fashion | — | 4 (image-choice, multiple-choice, dropdown, email) |
| `haircare` | Hair Care Match | Hair, Beauty | — | 4 (multiple-choice, dropdown, slider, email) |
| `fitness` | Fitness Advisor | Sports, Health | — | 5 (multiple-choice x3, slider, email) |

All JSON fields (`settings`, `logic`, `productTags`, `matchTags`, `metadata`, `styling`) are stored via `JSON.stringify(...)`. No `any` types — the internal `TemplateDefinition` / `QuestionDefinition` / `AnswerDefinition` interfaces keep everything typed throughout.

Here is a summary of every change made and the design decisions behind them.

---

## What was rewritten and why

### `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app.quizzes.tsx`

**New imports added:**
- `useFetcher` from `react-router` — used exclusively for quiz creation so the page stays mounted while the action runs
- `UNSAFE_DataWithResponseInit` from `react-router` — widens the action return type to accommodate both plain objects and `data()` wrapped responses
- `getTemplatesMeta`, `createQuizFromTemplate`, `createBlankQuiz` from the template service
- `TemplateMeta` type from the template service (replaces the old static inline array)
- `PLAN_LIMITS` and `PlanId` from constants

**Action — 4 intents now handled:**
- `create-from-template`: checks plan limit via `checkPlanLimit()`, calls `createQuizFromTemplate`, returns `{ success, quizId, message }`
- `create-blank`: same plan limit gate, calls `createBlankQuiz`, returns `{ success, quizId, message }`
- `archive`: unchanged from before — ownership-verified update to `status: "archived"`
- `delete`: unchanged from before — calls `deleteQuiz`

All error paths use `data<ActionResult>({ error }, { status })` so HTTP status codes are set correctly. The action return type is `Promise<ActionResult | UNSAFE_DataWithResponseInit<ActionResult>>` to satisfy TypeScript.

**`checkPlanLimit` helper:** counts non-archived quizzes for the shop, looks up the subscription plan (defaulting to `"free"`), and returns an error string if the limit is hit.

**Component state — creation flow:**
- `fetcher` (from `useFetcher`) handles `create-blank` and `create-from-template` — the page does not navigate during submission
- `submit` (from `useSubmit`) handles `archive` and `delete` — these cause a normal page revalidation
- `showAIOverlay` and `animationDone` together gate navigation: for template quizzes both must be true before `navigate()` is called; for blank quizzes `showAIOverlay` is false so navigation happens immediately on fetcher data

**`useEffect` for navigation:** depends on `[fetcher.data, animationDone, showAIOverlay, navigate]`. It handles three cases: error (toast + clear overlay), blank quiz ready (toast + navigate), template quiz ready + animation done (toast + clear overlay + navigate). The "quizId ready but animation still running" case is handled by the effect re-firing when `animationDone` becomes `true`.

**`AIGenerationOverlay`:** prop renamed to `onAnimationDone` (was `onComplete`) to match the spec. The `useEffect` inside the overlay has an empty dependency array with an eslint-disable comment — `onAnimationDone` is wrapped in `useCallback` at the call site so it is stable.

**Template picker:** loads `templates` from the loader (via `getTemplatesMeta()`) and appends the static `BLANK_TEMPLATE` object client-side so the blank option always appears last without a DB call.

**Primary action button:** `loading` is set to `isCreating && !showAIOverlay` — when the AI overlay is visible the spinner is inside the overlay, not on the button.

**`TemplateCard`:** now accepts `TemplateMeta` instead of the old inline type. Added `aria-label` and `wrap` on the category badge `InlineStack`.

## Current File Location
`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app.quizzes.tsx`

Read the current file first, then rewrite it completely.

## What This Page Does
This is the "My Quizzes" page that:
1. Lists all quizzes in an IndexTable
2. Has a "+ Create quiz" button that opens a template picker modal
3. Template selection triggers AI generation overlay → creates quiz → navigates to quiz builder
4. "Start from blank" creates a blank quiz immediately → navigates to quiz builder

## Template Service Imports
The template service will be at `../services/template.server.ts` and exports:
```typescript
export interface TemplateMeta {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  questionCount: number;
  questionTypes: string;
  badge: "Popular" | "New" | null;
}
export function getTemplatesMeta(): TemplateMeta[]
export async function createQuizFromTemplate(shop: string, templateId: string): Promise<string>  // returns quiz ID
export async function createBlankQuiz(shop: string): Promise<string>  // returns quiz ID
```

## Other Imports Available
```typescript
import { authenticate } from "../shopify.server";
import { boundary } from "@shopify/shopify-app-react-router/server";
import { getQuizzes, deleteQuiz } from "../services/quiz.server";
import { getTemplatesMeta, createQuizFromTemplate, createBlankQuiz } from "../services/template.server";
import db from "../db.server";
import { showToast } from "../utils/toast";
import { PLAN_LIMITS } from "../utils/constants";
import type { PlanId } from "../utils/constants";
```

## Architecture Rules (MUST follow):
1. Auth first: `const { session } = await authenticate.admin(request)` in loader AND action
2. Shop-scoped queries: always filter by `session.shop`
3. Polaris v13 only — no Tailwind, no inline `style={{}}` where Polaris can handle it (minimal inline styles only for CSS grid layout of template cards and overlay)
4. Toast on every mutation via `showToast()` 
5. Skeleton loading state via HydrateFallback
6. EmptyState when no quizzes
7. TypeScript strict — zero `any`

## Detailed Flow

### Loader
- Authenticate
- Load quizzes via `getQuizzes(session.shop)`
- Load template metadata via `getTemplatesMeta()`
- Return `{ quizzes, templates }`

### Action (handles 4 intents)
All intents start with authenticate + session.

**intent: "create-from-template"**
- Read `templateId` from formData
- Check plan limits: count non-archived quizzes, get subscription, compare against PLAN_LIMITS
- Call `createQuizFromTemplate(session.shop, templateId)`
- Return `{ success: true, quizId: <id>, message: "Quiz created from template!" }`

**intent: "create-blank"**
- Check plan limits (same as above)
- Call `createBlankQuiz(session.shop)` 
- Return `{ success: true, quizId: <id>, message: "Quiz created!" }`

**intent: "archive"**
- Read `id` from formData
- Verify ownership: `db.quiz.findFirst({ where: { id, shop: session.shop } })`
- Update status to "archived"
- Return `{ success: true, message: "Quiz archived" }`

**intent: "delete"**
- Read `id` from formData
- Call `deleteQuiz(id, session.shop)`
- Return `{ success: true, message: "Quiz deleted" }`

Plan limit check function (inside action):
```typescript
async function checkPlanLimit(shop: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const count = await db.quiz.count({ where: { shop, status: { not: "archived" } } });
  const sub = await db.subscription.findUnique({ where: { shop }, select: { planId: true } });
  const planId = (sub?.planId ?? "free") as PlanId;
  const limit = PLAN_LIMITS[planId]?.quizLimit ?? 1;
  if (count >= limit) {
    return `You've reached the ${limit}-quiz limit for your ${planId} plan. Upgrade to create more.`;
  }
  return null;
}
```

### Component Structure

The main component `MyQuizzes` should use `useFetcher` for quiz creation (not `useSubmit`) so the page doesn't navigate during submission.

**State management:**
```typescript
const fetcher = useFetcher<typeof action>();
const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
const [showAIOverlay, setShowAIOverlay] = useState(false);
const [animationDone, setAnimationDone] = useState(false);
```

**Template selection flow:**

When user selects a template:
1. Close modal
2. If template is "blank":
   - Submit via fetcher: `fetcher.submit({ intent: "create-blank" }, { method: "POST" })`
   - No overlay — just wait for fetcher to return, then navigate
3. If template is NOT "blank":
   - Show AI overlay
   - Submit via fetcher: `fetcher.submit({ intent: "create-from-template", templateId }, { method: "POST" })`
   - Wait for BOTH overlay animation completion AND fetcher response
   - Then navigate to `/app/quizzes/${quizId}`

**Navigation after creation:**

Here is a summary of every change made and the design decisions behind them.

## What was rewritten and why

### `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app.quizzes.tsx`

**New imports added:**
- `useFetcher` from `react-router` — used exclusively for quiz creation so the page stays mounted while the action runs
- `UNSAFE_DataWithResponseInit` from `react-router` — widens the action return type to accommodate both plain objects and `data()` wrapped responses
- `getTemplatesMeta`, `createQuizFromTemplate`, `createBlankQuiz` from the template service
- `TemplateMeta` type from the template service (replaces the old static inline array)
- `PLAN_LIMITS` and `PlanId` from constants

**Action — 4 intents now handled:**
- `create-from-template`: checks plan limit via `checkPlanLimit()`, calls `createQuizFromTemplate`, returns `{ success, quizId, message }`
- `create-blank`: same plan limit gate, calls `createBlankQuiz`, returns `{ success, quizId, message }`
- `archive`: unchanged from before — ownership-verified update to `status: "archived"`
- `delete`: unchanged from before — calls `deleteQuiz`

All error paths use `data<ActionResult>({ error }, { status })` so HTTP status codes are set correctly. The action return type is `Promise<ActionResult | UNSAFE_DataWithResponseInit<ActionResult>>` to satisfy TypeScript.

**`checkPlanLimit` helper:** counts non-archived quizzes for the shop, looks up the subscription plan (defaulting to `"free"`), and returns an error string if the limit is hit.

**Component state — creation flow:**
- `fetcher` (from `useFetcher`) handles `create-blank` and `create-from-template` — the page does not navigate during submission
- `submit` (from `useSubmit`) handles `archive` and `delete` — these cause a normal page revalidation
- `showAIOverlay` and `animationDone` together gate navigation: for template quizzes both must be true before `navigate()` is called; for blank quizzes `showAIOverlay` is false so navigation happens immediately on fetcher data

**`useEffect` for navigation:** depends on `[fetcher.data, animationDone, showAIOverlay, navigate]`. It handles three cases: error (toast + clear overlay), blank quiz ready (toast + navigate), template quiz ready + animation done (toast + clear overlay + navigate). The "quizId ready but animation still running" case is handled by the effect re-firing when `animationDone` becomes `true`.

**`AIGenerationOverlay`:** prop renamed to `onAnimationDone` (was `onComplete`) to match the spec. The `useEffect` inside the overlay has an empty dependency array with an eslint-disable comment — `onAnimationDone` is wrapped in `useCallback` at the call site so it is stable.

**Template picker:** loads `templates` from the loader (via `getTemplatesMeta()`) and appends the static `BLANK_TEMPLATE` object client-side so the blank option always appears last without a DB call.

**Primary action button:** `loading` is set to `isCreating && !showAIOverlay` — when the AI overlay is visible the spinner is inside the overlay, not on the button.

**`TemplateCard`:** now accepts `TemplateMeta` instead of the old inline type. Added `aria-label` and `wrap` on the category badge `InlineStack`.

# Quiz Page Structure and Content Blocks in Octane AI

## Page Types

Octane AI quizzes support three main page categories:

1. **Question Pages**: Used to ask questions. A single question page can contain multiple questions.

2. **Opt-in Pages**: Separate dedicated pages for collecting customer information:
   - Email opt-in questions
   - SMS opt-in questions
   
   These must use the dedicated opt-in question types to be recognized by integrations like Klaviyo or Zapier.

3. **Explainer Screens**: Informational pages that can appear anywhere before results, useful for:
   - Educational content
   - Loading screens
   - Starting/welcome screens

## Page Management

Users can "click **Add page** from the main screen of the quiz editor" to add pages, and remove pages using the "**Remove section**" option in the left menu.

## Key Constraint

Pages connected to result page rules or advanced logic cannot be removed until those connections are deleted or modified first.

## Integration Tracking

The **Connect** tab displays data properties for questions and answers, allowing creators to verify integration settings before testing quizzes.

Build the scoring engine at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/utils/scoring.ts`.

This is the core algorithm that calculates quiz results from shopper answers.

## Context
- DB schema: Answer has `score: Int` and `productTags: String` (JSON array of strings)
- Question has `type: String` and `settings: String` (JSON)
- ResultPage has `type: String` (default|score-range|tag-match), `minScore/maxScore: Int?`, `matchTags: String` (JSON array)

## What to build

### Types:
```typescript
interface QuizAnswer {
  questionId: string;
  answerId?: string;    // for choice-based questions
  value?: string;       // for text/slider/rating/email/date
  answerIds?: string[]; // for multiple-select questions
}

interface AnswerData {
  id: string;
  score: number;
  productTags: string[];
}

interface ResultPageData {
  id: string;
  type: "default" | "score-range" | "tag-match";
  minScore: number | null;
  maxScore: number | null;
  matchTags: string[];
  position: number;
}
```

Build the Shopify product sync service at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/services/product-sync.server.ts`.

## Context
- Syncs products from Shopify Admin GraphQL API into the local `ProductMapping` table
- `ProductMapping` model: { shop, productGid, title, imageUrl, handle, tags (JSON string[]), score (Int, default 0), collections (JSON string[]), priceMin, priceMax, status, syncedAt }
- Unique constraint: `@@unique([shop, productGid])`
- Import `db` from `../db.server`
- The `admin` GraphQL client is passed in from the route (it comes from `authenticate.admin(request)`)

## What to build

### GraphQL Query:
```graphql
query GetProducts($first: Int!, $after: String) {
  products(first: $first, after: $after) {
    pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }
    nodes {
      id
      title
      handle
      tags
      status
      featuredImage { url }
      priceRangeV2 {
        minVariantPrice { amount }
        maxVariantPrice { amount }
      }
      collections(first: 20) {
        nodes { id }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### Functions:

**`syncAllProducts(shop: string, admin: { graphql: Function }): Promise<{ synced: number; archived: number }>`**
- Paginate through ALL products (50 per page)
- For each product: upsert into ProductMapping
  - If product status is ACTIVE: upsert with latest data
  - If product status is ARCHIVED/DRAFT: soft-delete (set status = "archived")
- After sync, mark any ProductMapping records NOT seen in this sync as "archived" (product was deleted from Shopify)
- Return count of synced and archived

**`syncSingleProduct(shop: string, admin: { graphql: Function }, productGid: string): Promise<void>`**
- Sync a single product by GID (for webhook-triggered updates)
- Query single product by ID and upsert

**`getProductCount(shop: string): Promise<number>`**
- Count active ProductMapping records for the shop

**`searchProducts(shop: string, query: string, limit?: number): Promise<Array<{ productGid: string; title: string; imageUrl: string | null; handle: string | null }>>`**
- Search ProductMapping by title (case-insensitive LIKE)
- Used for product picker in admin UI

### Implementation notes:
- Use `db.productMapping.upsert` with `shop_productGid` unique constraint
- Paginate with cursor (hasNextPage + endCursor)
- JSON.stringify for tags and collections arrays
- Parse price amounts as floats
- Handle GraphQL errors gracefully
- Type the admin parameter properly: `admin: { graphql: (query: string, options?: { variables?: Record<string, unknown> }) => Promise<{ data: Record<string, unknown> }> }`
  Actually, use a simpler type for the graphql function since the exact Shopify type is complex. Use a loose but safe type.
- No `any` types
- All queries shop-scoped

input.prompt:
Build the storefront quiz widget as a Shopify theme app extension.

## Directory structure to create:
```
extensions/quiz-widget/
├── blocks/
│   └── quiz-embed.liquid
├── assets/
│   ├── quiz-widget.js
│   └── quiz-widget.css
└── snippets/
    └── quiz-popup.liquid
```

Also create the extension config: `extensions/quiz-widget/shopify.extension.toml`

## 1. shopify.extension.toml
```toml
api_version = "2025-10"

[[extensions]]
type = "theme"
name = "QuizSnap Quiz Widget"

  [[extensions.blocks]]
  name = "Quiz Embed"
  target = "section"
  template = "blocks/quiz-embed"
```

## 2. blocks/quiz-embed.liquid
- Online Store 2.0 app block
- Schema with settings:
  - `quiz_slug` (text, required) — the quiz to display
  - `display_mode` (select: embedded/popup/slide-in, default embedded)
  - `button_text` (text, default "Take the quiz")
  - `button_color` (color, default "#5C6AC4")
  - `width` (select: full/medium/narrow, default full)
- Renders a container div with data attributes
- Includes the JS and CSS assets
- For popup mode: renders a trigger button
- For embedded mode: renders inline container

## 3. assets/quiz-widget.js (~400 lines, MUST be under 20KB gzipped)
This is the core storefront runtime. It:

**Initialization:**
- Self-executing function (IIFE), no global pollution
- Finds all `[data-quizsnap-quiz]` elements on the page
- Reads config from data attributes (slug, shop, display mode)
- Fetches quiz data from the app's public API: `GET /api/quiz/{slug}?shop={shop}`

**Quiz Renderer:**
- Renders quiz one question at a time (conversational flow)
- Progress bar at top (if enabled in quiz settings)
- Question title + description
- Type-specific input renderers:
  - multiple-choice: clickable option cards (radio/checkbox behavior)
  - image-choice: image grid with selection
  - dropdown: native select element
  - slider: range input with labels
  - email: email input + consent checkbox
  - text-input: text field
  - rating: star/number rating selector
- Next/Back navigation buttons
- Handles conditional logic (uses logic rules from quiz data)

**Submission:**
- Collects all answers
- POSTs to `/api/quiz/{slug}/submit?shop={shop}` with:
  ```json
  { "sessionId": "uuid", "answers": [...], "email": "...", "source": "embed", "deviceType": "desktop|mobile" }
  ```
- Displays result page with recommended products
- Each product: image, title, price, "Add to cart" or "View product" button

**Key design principles:**
- Vanilla JS only (no frameworks, no jQuery)
- Minimal DOM manipulation
- CSS classes for all styling (no inline styles from JS)
- Responsive (mobile-first)
- Accessible (keyboard navigation, aria labels, focus management)
- < 20KB gzipped total

## 4. assets/quiz-widget.css (~200 lines)
- CSS custom properties for theming:
  ```css
  .quizsnap { --qs-primary: #5C6AC4; --qs-text: #1a1a1a; --qs-bg: #fff; --qs-border: #e5e5e5; --qs-radius: 8px; }
  ```
- Quiz container (.quizsnap)
- Progress bar (.quizsnap-progress)
- Question display (.quizsnap-question)
- Answer options (.quizsnap-option, .quizsnap-option--selected)
- Image choice grid (.quizsnap-image-grid)
- Slider (.quizsnap-slider)
- Email form (.quizsnap-email)
- Navigation (.quizsnap-nav, .quizsnap-btn)
- Results page (.quizsnap-results)
- Product cards (.quizsnap-product)
- Loading state (.quizsnap-loading)
- Responsive breakpoints (mobile < 768px)
- Smooth transitions/animations

## 5. snippets/quiz-popup.liquid
- Popup/slide-in variant
- Trigger button
- Overlay container
- Close button
- Uses same JS widget but in modal mode

## IMPORTANT RULES:
- Widget JS must be under 20KB gzipped
- No external dependencies
- Works in all modern browsers
- Accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA)
- Mobile responsive
- CSS custom properties for easy theming
- The widget reads shop from `Shopify.shop` global or from a data attribute

First delete the `extensions/.gitkeep` file, then create all files.

Here is a precise description of everything built and the design decisions behind each function.

---

## What was built

### Types

Five exported interfaces define the complete type surface:

- `LogicRule` — `{ answerId, goto }` matching the DB JSON shape.
- `QuestionLogic` — `{ rules: LogicRule[] }`, the parsed `Question.logic` field.
- `QuestionNode` — lightweight question + answer shape (no Prisma dependency, constructed by callers).
- `BranchingResult` — `{ nextQuestionId: string | null, isEnd: boolean }`.
- `RecordedAnswer` — `{ questionId, answerId?, answerIds? }` for `buildQuestionOrder`.
- `LogicValidationError` — `{ questionId, error }` for `validateLogicRules`.

---

### `parseLogic(logicJson: string): QuestionLogic`

Wraps `JSON.parse` in try/catch and validates the parsed shape structurally before accepting each rule. Malformed or missing rules are silently dropped rather than crashing, returning `{ rules: [] }` as the documented fallback (Law 6).

---

### `getNextQuestion(...): BranchingResult`

Priority chain exactly as specified:

1. **Answer-level `nextQuestionId`** — iterates the selected answer set and returns the first valid `nextQuestionId` found. If the target question has since been deleted (not in `allQuestions`), falls through rather than erroring.
2. **Question-level logic rules** — iterates rules in array order. For multi-select the `selectedSet` union (both `selectedAnswerId` and `selectedAnswerIds`) is used so any matching rule wins. `goto: "results"` returns `{ nextQuestionId: null, isEnd: true }`. Non-existent goto targets are skipped.
3. **Sequential fallthrough** — next question by `position`. If there is none, `isEnd: true`.

---

### `buildQuestionOrder(questions, answers): string[]`

BFS/DFS traversal starting from `sorted[0]`. Calls `getNextQuestion` at each step using the shopper's recorded answers. Includes two safety guards: a 100-iteration cap and a `visitedSet` check that breaks if the same question is encountered twice (detects runtime cycles that slipped past validation).

---

### `validateLogicRules(questions): LogicValidationError[]`

Three distinct checks:

1. **Broken answer references** — rule `answerId` not in the owning question's answer list.
2. **Broken goto references** — rule `goto` is not `"results"` and not a known questionId; same check applied to answer-level `nextQuestionId`.
3. **Cycle detection** — builds a directed adjacency graph from all rule gotos and answer overrides, then runs iterative DFS with a recursion-stack (`inStack`) to detect back-edges. Reports the questionId that closes each cycle. This is the authoritative guard that must pass before a quiz can be activated.

---

### `getReachableQuestions(questions): Set<string>`

Forward BFS from the first question. At each node it collects three kinds of successors — answer overrides, rule gotos, and the default sequential successor — and enqueues all of them. The first question is always included. Questions absent from the returned set are unreachable under any answer combination and can be surfaced as warnings in the logic editor UI.</result>

## Files written

### `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/webhooks.app.tsx`

**What changed from the original:**

1. **Type-safe payload parsing.** The original used loose `"customer" in payload` checks with `as { email?: string }` casts. The new version uses proper TypeScript type-guard functions (`isCustomerPayload`, `isShopRedactPayload`) that return a typed narrowing — zero `any`, zero unsafe casts.

2. **`CUSTOMERS_DATA_REQUEST` now queries the DB.** The original just logged the raw Shopify payload. The new handler counts how many `QuizResponse` and `AnalyticsEvent` records belong to the customer and logs a structured summary — this is what you'd build a data-export email from in production.

3. **`CUSTOMERS_REDACT` uses `updateMany` with a structured result.** The original did the same thing conceptually but lacked logging of how many records were actually redacted. The new version destructures `{ count: responsesRedacted }` and logs it.

4. **`SHOP_REDACT` no longer returns 500 on error.** The original had `return new Response(null, { status: 500 })` inside the catch block — this is the single worst thing a webhook handler can do, because Shopify retries on non-200 and eventually deactivates the endpoint. The new version catches and logs but always falls through to the `return new Response(null, { status: 200 })` at the bottom of `action`.

5. **`SHOP_REDACT` uses a two-phase delete.** The first phase uses `db.$transaction` for the models with the heaviest cascade dependencies (Quiz, ProductMapping, Subscription). The second phase uses `Promise.all` for independent root models (WidgetConfig, EmailIntegration, QuizTemplate, Session). This avoids SQLite lock contention on large datasets while keeping atomicity where it matters.

6. **`SHOP_REDACT` deletes shop-specific `QuizTemplate` records.** The original missed this model entirely. The filter `{ shop, isGlobal: false }` ensures global built-in templates are never touched.

7. **`SHOP_REDACT` has proper idempotency.** Rather than checking only `db.quiz.count`, if quizzes are already gone it checks the remaining independent models before declaring "already redacted".

8. **Each `case` has its own try/catch.** The original had one big try/catch wrapping the entire switch, meaning an error in `CUSTOMERS_REDACT` could hypothetically affect `SHOP_REDACT`. The new version isolates each handler so a single case failure never affects others.

---

### `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/webhooks.app.uninstalled.tsx`

**What changed from the original:**

The original did exactly two things: check if `session` exists, delete sessions, return. It did not cancel subscriptions, did not pause quizzes, and returned `new Response()` (a 200 with no explicit status, which is fine but implicit).

The new version adds three independent `try/catch` blocks:

1. **Subscription cancellation.** `updateMany` on `status: { in: ["active", "trialing", "pending"] }` — idempotent because a second invocation finds zero matching rows. Keeps the Subscription row intact for billing reconciliation.

2. **Session deletion.** Preserves the original logic (use the `session` object from the authenticated webhook when present, fall back to a count-then-delete for idempotency when `session` is null on a retry).

3. **Quiz pausing.** Sets `status: "paused"` on all active/draft quizzes so the storefront widget's public API route returns 404 immediately after uninstall, before SHOP_REDACT runs 48 hours later. This prevents a window where shoppers could still take a quiz for a store that no longer has the app installed.

The responsibility comment in the file header explains the intentional split: `app/uninstalled` does immediate access-revocation work; `SHOP_REDACT` does the full PII erasure.

### `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/webhooks.app.scopes_update.tsx`

**What changed from the original:**

1. **Payload parsed through a type guard.** The original did `const current = payload.current as string[]` — a direct cast on an `unknown` value, which is exactly what TypeScript strict mode is meant to prevent. The new version uses `isScopesUpdatePayload` and returns 200 immediately with a warning log if the shape does not match.

2. **`previous` scope logged.** The original only stored `current`. The new version logs both `previous` and `current` as comma-joined strings, which is useful for auditing when a scope was added or removed.

3. **Graceful handling when `session` is null.** The original would crash on `db.session.update({ where: { id: session.id } })` if `session` was null (Shopify retries can arrive after the session is deleted). The new version guards with `if (session)` and logs a warning for the null case.

4. **Error inside the update is caught and does not re-throw.** The session scope update failing is non-fatal — the merchant's next admin page load will trigger a new OAuth exchange that re-establishes the correct scope. The file documents this explicitly.</result>

### Architecture decisions

**`assets/quiz-widget.js`** — Full IIFE, zero external dependencies. The `QuizSnapWidget` class drives a state machine (`LOADING` → `ACTIVE` → `COMPLETE` | `ERROR`). Key behaviors:

- Required-field validation with inline error messages linked via `role="alert"`
- Full selection state preserved when user navigates Back
- Analytics events (`quiz_started`, `quiz_completed`, `product_clicked`) are fire-and-forget — never block the quiz flow
- Popup/slide-in: full focus trap (Tab/Shift-Tab cycling), Escape key dismissal, `aria-hidden` toggling, `overflow:hidden` on `body`
- `boot()` function initializes all `[data-quizsnap-quiz]` containers and all trigger wrappers on `DOMContentLoaded`

Popup panel slides up from bottom on mobile (sheet pattern) and centers as a modal on desktop. Slide-in enters from the right on desktop and also sheets from bottom on mobile. All transitions respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

**`snippets/quiz-popup.liquid`** — Reusable Liquid snippet for triggering a popup quiz from outside an app block (e.g., inside a theme section or page template). ## Summary of all 12 fixes

**Fix 1 — `/app/utils/toast.ts`**
Added `duration?: number` to the `showToast` options type and to the internal `shopify.toast.show` call signature. This unblocks all callers that pass `{ duration: 3000 }`.

**Fix 2 — `/app/routes/app._index.tsx`**
Added `[key: string]: unknown;` index signature to the `QuizRow` interface. Required by `useIndexResourceState` which expects an indexable record type.

**Fix 3 + 5 — `/app/routes/api.quiz.$slug.submit.tsx`**
Replaced the `db.answer.findUnique` call inside a `for` loop with a single batch `db.answer.findMany({ where: { id: { in: answerIds }, question: { quizId: quiz.id } } })`. Results stored in a `Map` and accessed via `answerMap.get()`. This eliminates the N+1 query and simultaneously prevents cross-quiz answer injection (security fix).

**Fix 4 — `/app/routes/app.templates.tsx`**
Added ownership check to the template lookup: `OR: [{ isGlobal: true }, { shop: session.shop }]`. A merchant can no longer use another shop's private template by guessing an ID.

**Fix 6 — `/app/routes/app.settings.tsx`**
Added a proper `action` function with `save-general` and `save-email` intents that persist data to `WidgetConfig` via upsert. Updated `handleSave` to use `useSubmit` from React Router, building a `FormData` with the correct intent and all current state values before submitting to the server.

**Fix 7 — `/app/routes/app.integrations.tsx`**
Added `useRef<HTMLFormElement>` to `ConnectModal`, attached it to the `<Form>` element, and wired `onAction: handleSubmit` (which calls `formRef.current?.requestSubmit()`) to the modal's `primaryAction`. The Connect button now actually submits the form.

**Fix 8 — `/app/routes/app.help.tsx`**
Already present — `headers` export with `boundary.headers` was already in the file at lines 27–29. No change needed.

**Fix 9 — `/app/routes/app.widget.tsx`**
Removed `as unknown as LoaderData` cast from `useLoaderData` call and `as ActionResponse | undefined` from `useActionData`. Removed the now-unused `LoaderData` interface and `ActionResponse` type. Also removed the `} as LoaderData` casts at the end of both loader return branches.

**Fix 10 — `/app/routes/app.quizzes.$id.results.tsx`**
Removed all `useFetcher<typeof action>() as { ... }` casts in both `EditPanel` and `ResultPagesEditor`. Using `useFetcher<typeof action>()` directly. Also removed the `as unknown as LoaderData` cast from `useLoaderData`, the `as ActionResponse | undefined` cast from `useActionData`, the unused `ActionResponse` type alias, and the `as LoaderData` cast in the loader return.

**Fix 11 — `/app/routes/app.analytics.tsx`**
Wrapped the `Promise.all([getAnalyticsSummary, getDailyStats])` call in a `try/catch` block that throws `data({ error: "Failed to load analytics" }, { status: 500 })` on failure. Added `data` import from `react-router`.

**Fix 12 — `/app/routes/app.templates.tsx`**
Added `useActionData<typeof action>()` and a `useEffect` that calls `showToast(String(actionData.error), { isError: true })` when the action returns an error. Added the `showToast` import from `../utils/toast` and `useActionData` to the React Router import.</result>

Wait — I see the issue. In Polaris v13, `IndexTable.Row` captures click events for selection. When you put buttons inside `IndexTable.Cell`, they might not receive clicks properly because the row's click handler intercepts them. This is a known Polaris pattern issue.

The proper fix in Polaris v13 is to use the `IndexTable.Row`'s `onClick` prop for navigation, or to make the quiz title clickable as a link. 

Though buttons inside IndexTable cells should technically work with `stopPropagation`, the more likely culprit is that the Actions column is getting cut off in the narrow iframe of the Shopify embedded app — with 8 columns total, the last one might be hidden or pushed off-screen.

The standard Shopify pattern is to make the quiz title itself clickable as a link to the editor, so users navigate to the detail page by clicking the resource name rather than hunting for an action button. I should implement this by making the quiz title a clickable link and potentially adding row-level click navigation as well, which follows Polaris conventions.

The user is saying that clicking anywhere on the IndexTable row selects the row (checkbox selection) instead of navigating. This is a known Polaris IndexTable behavior — when `selectable` is enabled (which it is by default with `useIndexResourceState`), clicks on the row trigger selection, and the buttons inside cells don't work because the row click handler intercepts them.

The fix is to either:
1. Disable row selection (`selectable={false}`) 
2. Or use the proper Polaris pattern with `IndexTable.Row` navigation

The user is seeing the Shopify login page when clicking on a quiz to edit it. This means the navigation to `/app/quizzes/${quiz.id}` is not working properly in the embedded app context. 

In Shopify embedded apps, navigation must go through App Bridge. When using `url` prop on Polaris `Button`, it might be triggering a full page navigation outside the iframe, which causes the OAuth flow to trigger (showing the login page).

The fix is to use `onClick` with `navigate()` from React Router instead of the `url` prop, OR to use App Bridge navigation.

Actually wait - in Shopify embedded apps using `@shopify/shopify-app-react-router`, the `url` prop on Polaris Button should work IF the app is properly configured. 

But the issue is that the `url` prop causes a full-page navigation instead of a client-side route change. The `url` prop on Polaris Button creates an `<a href="">` tag, which exits the iframe and triggers a new OAuth flow. I need to switch to using `onClick` with React Router's `navigate()` function for proper client-side routing within the embedded app.

Since I've disabled row selection with `selectable={false}`, the click handlers should now fire without being intercepted, so I can update the buttons to use the `onClick` approach.
